# `cleanup-after-fallible-operation`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports cleanup registered only after another fallible operation can exit the
scope.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An error between acquisition and cleanup registration leaks the newly acquired
resource.

## When it fires

It applies to recognized resource bindings followed by `try` or another proven
early-error point before `defer` or `errdefer`.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    const a = try gpa.alloc(u8, 8);
    const b = try gpa.alloc(u8, 8);
    defer gpa.free(a);
    defer gpa.free(b);
}
```
